node.info:
DatabaseHeader

SQLite Database Header (first 100 bytes) - Critical forensic artifact containing database metadata
node.name: DatabaseHeader

node.info:
HeaderString

SQLite format signature: 'SQLite format 3\0'. Corruption or modification indicates tampering.

Value: SQLite format 3

Size: 16 bytes

Offset: 0x0 (0)
node.name: HeaderString

node.info:
PageSize

Database page size in bytes (power of 2, 512-65536). 1 means 65536. Critical for page boundary calculations.

Value: 4096

Size: 2 bytes

Offset: 0x10 (16)
node.name: PageSize

node.info:
WriteVersion

File format write version. Indicates journal mode - check for associated -wal and -journal files. = WAL mode - look for .db-wal and .db-shm files

Value: 2 (WAL mode - look for .db-wal and .db-shm files)

Size: 1 bytes

Offset: 0x12 (18)
node.name: WriteVersion

node.info:
ReadVersion

File format read version. Must match WriteVersion for proper operation. = WAL mode

Value: 2 (WAL mode)

Size: 1 bytes

Offset: 0x13 (19)
node.name: ReadVersion

node.info:

Bytes of unused space at end of each page. Non-zero may indicate encryption (SQLCipher uses this).

Value: 0

Size: 1 bytes

Offset: 0x14 (20)
node.name: ReservedSpacePerPage

node.info:

Value: 64

Size: 1 bytes

Offset: 0x15 (21)
